svg.title: Round 1 similarity matrix
svg.desc: A grid of cosine similarity scores between six old-revision elements down the left and seven new-revision elements across the top. Most cells sit in an ambiguous mid range around 0.3 to 0.5. Two cells, ck.b to dl.q at 0.91 and bn.s to hf.n at 0.88, are far darker than any alternative in their row and column and are outlined as promoted. Two rows contend for the same column hf.b at 0.68 and 0.66, and one column ry.z has no strong match anywhere.
